services.lead: Ramdas Accounting helps minimize tax liability for individuals and families with leading industry knowledge and practices. Whether you are a first time filer, need to amend your IRS return or have a more complex situation, we are here to help prepare and e-file your necessary forms.
services.imageAlt: A calculator and a tax form on a desk

covers.title: Tax preparation
covers.text: One-on-one personalized assistance from a licensed tax professional rather than a computer program.

covers.title: A wide range of situations
covers.text: Small business income, rental properties, high net worth, stock options, partnership K-1's, and expatriate and international tax needs.

covers.title: A tax organizer in January
covers.text: Returning clients receive a tax organizer as a basic backbone of questions to get started. New clients receive everything needed as soon as they decide to come on.

covers.title: Secure upload and e-filing
covers.text: Upload and access your documents through the online portal instead of mailing them, and your filed return is uploaded there for your records.

covers.title: Questions year round
covers.text: Our staff is on hand whether you need help getting your taxes together, an extension, or tax planning help later in the year.

questions.q: What do I get to help me gather my documents?
questions.a: In January we provide returning clients with a tax organizer to act as a basic backbone of questions to get you started. New clients receive everything needed as soon as they decide to come on.

questions.q: Do I have to mail my documents in?
questions.a: No. By signing up and using our online portal you can securely upload and access all of your tax documents without mailing them.

services.title: IRS Representation
services.summary: Help with IRS debt, levies, liens and audits.
services.text: We will represent you in front of the IRS and work to develop a solution that is best for you, whether it is back returns, an audit, a lien or a levy.
services.lead: At Ramdas Accounting we understand how overwhelming working with the IRS can be. With a reduced IRS staff and an increase in notices being mailed, we are here to be your advocate.
services.imageAlt: A person at a desk holding a sign reading help

covers.title: Failure to file
covers.text: We gather your tax information and file your back returns. Until those are filed we cannot help minimize your back tax debt and penalties.

covers.title: Audits
covers.text: We handle all communication with the IRS so you can focus on your life. Send us the notice and we take care of it.

covers.title: Liens and levies
covers.text: A lien is a legal claim against your property to secure payment of your tax debt; a levy actually takes the property. Contact us immediately and we begin negotiating on your behalf.

covers.title: Offer in Compromise
covers.text: An agreement we write that negotiates with the IRS to settle your debt for less than what you owe.

covers.title: Penalties and installment agreements
covers.text: Where the tax owed cannot be lowered we negotiate lower penalties and interest, or an installment agreement that pays small portions over a set period.

covers.title: The order of the notices
covers.text: Notice CP14 arrives first, then the CP501 and CP503 reminders, then CP504 by certified mail as a notice of intent to levy that lets the IRS claim your state tax refund, and last the Notice of Intent to Levy and Notice of Your Right to a Hearing, also by certified mail.

questions.q: What should I do first if the IRS contacts me?
questions.a: If you receive a notice by mail or phone, the first thing you need to do is contact us. Fighting the notices on your own can cost you more than the tax itself did.

questions.q: How long before the IRS can seize anything?
questions.a: The IRS legally cannot take anything from you until 30 days after the date of your final notice of intent to levy.

services.title: Tax + Financial Planning
services.summary: Planning for retirement, education and goals.
services.text: We help you plan for the future and achieve your goals in an ever-changing financial and regulatory environment with thorough analysis and creative solutions.
services.lead: Many taxpayers know a CPA can prepare their personal income taxes, but as personal financial planners CPAs can also help you make an investment into your own future. Personal financial planning helps individuals at all income levels.
services.imageAlt: A pile of United States coins

covers.title: Three questions first
covers.text: Where are you now, where do you want to be, and how are you going to get there.

covers.title: Investment options explained
covers.text: Mutual funds, certificates of deposit, real estate, bonds, stocks, investment and retirement funds, with the risks, liquidity and tax characteristics set out.

covers.title: Retirement and pensions
covers.text: How much to contribute to retirement accounts and an evaluation of your pension.

covers.title: Budgeting and debt
covers.text: Determining the amount of money you need to reach your goals, maintain your lifestyle or pay off debts.

covers.title: A second opinion
covers.text: An objective review of other advisors' recommendations.

questions.q: Do I need a certain income level for financial planning?
questions.a: No. Personal financial planning can help individuals from all income levels.

questions.q: Are you only available at tax time?
questions.a: No. We are available year round. Pick up the phone, send an e-mail or schedule a meeting anytime if you have a question or would like to stop by.

services.title: Corporate Tax
services.summary: Business returns, payroll filings and planning.
services.text: We help businesses year round meet their tax and regulatory needs in a timely, professional manner, working alongside you and your staff to maximize deductions and reduce tax liability.
services.lead: As a corporation you are subject to tax and must submit a tax return similarly to individuals. There are a few different kinds of corporate structures, each with its own forms, intricacies and due dates, and we keep up with the laws and the changes to them to keep your business paying the least income taxes possible.

covers.title: Corporate returns
covers.text: Federal and any or all state returns, personally prepared and reviewed by our CPA staff and filed electronically.

covers.title: Payroll filings
covers.text: W-2's, 1099's and 940's. Provide names and amounts paid and we do the rest.

covers.title: Entity selection
covers.text: We can help you determine whether your business is currently the best entity for tax minimization, and assist with filing for a change in corporate structure.

covers.title: A predecessor accountant
covers.text: We obtain all of your necessary information without any extra effort on your part so you can focus on your business and customers.

covers.title: Tax planning
covers.text: A tax strategy that benefits you all year and plans that change as the laws change.

covers.title: An organizer and a document list
covers.text: You receive a tax organizer as a basic backbone of questions, along with a list of the tax documents generally needed to complete the return.

questions.a: The due date for many payroll forms, including W-2's, 1099's and 940's, is January 31st. The corporate tax due date is March 15th.

questions.q: What does it cost to talk it through first?
questions.a: Our services start with a free consultation. Come and tell us what you need and we will let you know how we can help.

services.title: Audit + Review + Compilation
services.summary: Three levels of financial statement assurance.
services.text: Audits, reviews and compilations provide varying levels of assurance on your financial statements. Whether it is a stockholder, creditor, investor or bank, we provide the intended party a report with the requested level of assurance.
services.lead: The purpose of financial statement assurance is to add credibility and assure the reliability of a company's financial statements. We view our role in the financial reporting process as an opportunity to provide constructive solutions for maximizing your company's profitability and efficiency.
services.imageAlt: One person handing a clipboard of documents to another

covers.title: Compilation
covers.text: The lowest level of assurance. The objective is to assist management in presenting financial statements, and the CPA's report will not express an opinion or provide assurance regarding them.

covers.title: Review
covers.text: The middle level. The objective is limited assurance that there are no material modifications needed for the statements to conform with GAAP, with all required footnotes and disclosures included.

covers.title: Audit
covers.text: The highest level of assurance available from independent CPAs, including confirming bank balances, verifying reconciliations and checks, and an assessment of internal control.

covers.title: What a review looks at
covers.text: At a minimum the accounting practices the organization uses, the procedures for recording and storing financial information, and the actions taken at stockholder or board meetings, with inquiries directed to the management responsible for financial and accounting matters.

covers.title: What an audit report says
covers.text: A report on whether the financial statements present fairly in all material respects and in conformity with GAAP, with a statement of changes in financial statements and detailed, referenced footnotes setting out accounting methods, policies and certain financial data.

covers.title: Knowing your industry
covers.text: Each assurance service requires we have the knowledge of your business and industry, so we can offer focused insight on your internal controls and operations.

questions.q: Which level of assurance do I need?
questions.a: Audits are most often required by banks or lenders while others may be satisfied with a lesser level. Contact us and we will help determine which option is right for you.

questions.q: What else comes out of an audit?
questions.a: The CPA may become aware of weaknesses in internal controls or organizational systems and offer suggestions for improvement.

services.title: Advisory + Business Development
services.summary: Starting, growing or selling a business.
services.text: Whether you would like to start a business, grow your current business or sell a business, we are here to help at every pivotal point in your business life cycle.
services.lead: From great ideas on a notepad to established multimillion dollar corporations, we are experienced in helping business owners make the best decisions to improve their bottom lines and their businesses as a whole.
services.imageAlt: People seated around a boardroom table during a presentation

covers.title: Formation
covers.text: Perfecting your business plan, determining your start-up capital requirements and helping you find sources of capital if necessary.

covers.title: Business structure
covers.text: Deciding what is best for you by weighing tax advantages, ease of operation and possible relocation, and legal exposure, then filing the state and federal paperwork.

covers.title: Growth and management
covers.text: Analyzing businesses and evaluating cost reductions, forecasting and strategizing growth, including whether a merger is right for you and your employees.

covers.title: Virtual CFO and bookkeeping
covers.text: Invoicing, budgeting, recording your daily transactions and closing your books.

covers.title: Valuation and sale
covers.text: An objective, skilled valuation for a merger, a sale or a dispute, aimed at the best possible sales price or payout terms.

covers.title: Protocols, payroll and insurance
covers.text: Once the business starts taking off we help set up your business protocol and procedures, from payroll start up to buying business insurance.

questions.q: Do you only work with established companies?
questions.a: No. We work with businesses from great ideas on a notepad to established multimillion dollar corporations.

questions.q: Can you just check over the books we already keep?
questions.a: Yes. If you are doing just fine and want someone to check over your books, we can do that too.

services.title: Quickbooks + Bookkeeping
services.summary: Setup, clean up and ongoing bookkeeping.
services.text: We specialize in Quickbooks and can manage all aspects of your bookkeeping, from a fresh set of books to monthly or quarterly review.
services.lead: Is your business growing and your bookkeeping taking up more and more of your time, but still not enough to hire someone full time? Are your books hard to even look at? We are available to help you with any and all aspects of your bookkeeping needs.

covers.title: Quickbooks set up
covers.text: Our Certified Quickbooks ProAdvisor helps you determine what accounts you need, how to handle beginning balances, how to set up Quickbooks Payroll and how to link your bank accounts.

covers.title: Quickbooks clean up
covers.text: From accounts with confusing balances to far too many accounts, we clean your books up and get them current. Send us your documents and file.

covers.title: Monthly or quarterly review
covers.text: We reconcile your accounts and make sure transactions are entered, clean up your General Ledger, generate accurate company reports and provide ongoing consultation.

covers.title: Quickbooks Online
covers.text: Working online we help clients from around the world, in real time, from everyday bookkeeping to once a month reconciliations.

covers.title: Training your staff
covers.text: From training staff to do a few key transactions to fully taking on your books.

questions.q: Does the initial setup really matter?
questions.a: Yes. Although Quickbooks has been designed to be easy to understand, the initial setup and framework of your books must be done correctly to ensure everything stays accurate.
Having accurate reports is the only way for you or your bank to analyze how your business is doing, whether you are looking for a loan or need to show new potential shareholders.

services.title: Non-Profit Accounting
services.text: We help maintain your non-profit's 501(c)(3) federal tax-exempt status by handling all the IRS reporting for you, including Form 990.
services.lead: Your focus running a non-profit is not the money, it is the mission. We understand the tax and financial needs of non-profit organizations through experience, and our current work with other non-profits lets us stay on top of changing industry regulations and issues.
services.imageAlt: Silhouettes of a line of people standing together

covers.title: Form 990
covers.text: The lengthy yearly return that reports your income and expenses to the IRS. The IRS makes it publicly available, so it is vital that it contains accurate information.

covers.title: Schools and universities
covers.text: We work with your members and governing body to properly account for and file the requisite tax forms at an affordable rate.

covers.title: Budgets and forecasting
covers.text: Help organizing and forming budgets and forecasting financial climates.

covers.title: Everyday bookkeeping
covers.text: One time services all the way up to full time support, whatever your income level or level of need.

covers.title: IRS audits
covers.text: We help your organization with IRS audits as well as its reporting.

questions.q: Do you only work with 501(c)(3) organizations?
questions.a: No. We help 501(c)(3) clients and also religious institutions and even small clubs and associations.

questions.q: Why does a non-profit need an accountant?
questions.a: Most non-profits do not have an accountant on staff, and timely, accurate financial information and statements help your organization plan and move ahead.

services.title: Trust + Estate + Gift Tax
services.summary: Trust formation, estate returns and gift tax.
services.text: We can assist you with the formation and tax filing for all types of trusts, estates and gifts, and work alongside your attorney and financial planners.
services.lead: Having a will or trust is not everything estate planning is about. We aim to help make sure you have the appropriate tools in place to enable the transfer of your assets to your loved ones with as little difficulty, tax and time as possible.
services.imageAlt: A last will and testament document with a pen resting on it

covers.title: Estates
covers.text: Estate tax return preparation at both the federal and state level, coordinated across all related returns of the decedent and beneficiaries.

covers.title: Working with your advisors
covers.text: Our staff works with your attorney to analyze your will, retirement plan, insurance policies and business succession plans to minimize estate taxes.

covers.title: Trusts
covers.text: Formation and tax filing for revocable, irrevocable, asset protection, discretionary, charitable, special needs, spendthrift, constructive and tax by-pass trusts, including the yearly Form 1041.

covers.title: Gifts
covers.text: If you gave a taxable gift during the year we help you account for it on Form 709 and calculate your lifetime exclusion.

covers.title: What is excluded, and splitting a gift
covers.text: Directly paid educational and medical expenses are excluded, and married individuals can combine their gift to one recipient, though doing so means filing a gift tax return.

covers.title: How the tax is worked out
covers.text: The tax on gifts over the yearly exclusion is added to the tax over the gift limit from previous years and applied against your lifetime exclusion; once that sum exceeds the lifetime exclusion, gift tax may be owed.

questions.q: I already have an estate plan. Is that enough?
questions.a: With all of the changes in estate tax codes over the past few years, and more being predicted, we recommend a review of your plan to make sure you are covered.

questions.q: Are gifts I give tax deductible?
questions.a: No, this is the opposite of the truth. A gift tax return must be filed if you gift over the annual exclusion per recipient.

process.title: Our process
process.text: The same four steps whether you are filing a personal return or running a company.

steps.title: A customized tax organizer
steps.text: Receive a customized tax organizer that will help you collect all of your necessary tax information.

steps.title: Send it back your way
steps.text: Return the organizer with pertinent tax documents to us by the method that is most convenient for you.

steps.title: Ten business days
steps.text: Expect your tax return to be prepared within ten business days for your review, signature, filing and payment.

steps.title: All year, not just April
steps.text: Consult with Ramdas Accounting throughout the year for all of your tax, financial, representation and planning needs.

about.title: A Woodlands CPA firm specializing in tax, audit and advisory services.
text: Ramdas Accounting, LLC. is a Woodlands based CPA firm specializing in tax, audit and advisory services for individuals and business entities. We keep up to date on new laws and regulations and we provide our clients with the best industry knowledge and expertise.

Rahul Ramdas started his accounting career at Texas A&M in College Station. His very first clients were Aggie students just like him. After completing his CPA designation, he founded Ramdas Accounting in 2009 in Houston before expanding offices to The Woodlands. We have since merged with two other accounting firms to expand our client base and now have over 100 years combined CPA income tax preparation service experience.

Although we might seem local, we also serve clients well beyond the Woodlands and Greater Houston Area from all around the world. Whether it is working with a multi-million dollar firm to discuss their quarterly financials, a mid-sized corporation dealing with their corporate taxes, or a small business or startup setting up their books, Ramdas Accounting provides reliable, quality tax and financial services.

values.title: Value-added accounting
values.text: A complete approach that covers individual tax, business tax, audit, accounting, bookkeeping and financial planning while saving time and money.

values.title: Reachable year round
values.text: We appreciate our clients and the trust they instill in us, and we make it a point to ensure that our clients can reach us anytime.

values.title: Personalized to you
values.text: We consistently exceed client expectations by personalizing our services to unique client needs and providing the highest level of quality service in our field.

values.title: Lasting relationships
values.text: Our purpose is to build lasting relationships with clients by providing the best tax and financial services possible, and meeting clients and getting to be a part of their everyday lives and work is what makes our job worth doing.

values.title: Pay less, preserve more
values.text: Hiring a CPA is one of the most financially important and beneficial investments you will ever make, and we work to ensure you pay less in taxes, preserve more of your wealth and plan for the unexpected.
